text:
deploybot: pin applied -> sdk/sdk-2.7.3 added to pinlist for scope=canary-us-east. reason=model-binding mismatch causing 5xxs on batch-infer. auto-notify infra and oncall. link: https://deploy.internal/pins/4965432109 :triangular_flag_on_post:
anita: saw this in SLO alerts, errors basically started after SDK bump in last deploy. stack shows deserialize mismatch when model signature includes optional tensors.
marco: is it deterministic? only on batched requests or single-shot too?
rachel: mostly batched. repro with multi-seq payload using quantized model. single requests usually fine. attaching a tiny repro snippet in python later.
tom: can we do a gradual pin instead of full-stop? prefer to avoid hard rollback during business hours. what does the automation do by default?
deploybot: automation policy = soft-pin for SDK level pins. traffic to canary-us-east will route new requests to sdk-2.7.2 fallback. existing sessions pinned to 2.7.3 for up to 3m. TTL=4h. manual overrides available.
ci-bot: ci: patch candidate built -> refactor/skip-opt-optional-tensors (#4123) ✅ tests green (unit + integration).
anita: great. request: can we run the patch as a staged rollforward to 3 canary nodes and validate traces for 30m before unpin? If passes, unpin early.
marco: guardrails suggestion: abort rollforward and trigger rollback if 5xx frequency > 0.8% for 10m OR p95 latency regresses by >150ms. also watch memory since we've seen deserialization buffer blips.
rachel: I'll prepare a short release note blurb. something like: "Canary pin of SDK 2.7.3 in us-east due to model-binding edge-case; patch under probe."
tom: please add runbook link: https://docs.internal/runbooks/sdk-binding-failures and put ops slack channel #eng-oncall in the post.
ci-bot: staging rollforward scheduled at 4965432120 -> nodes: c1,c2,c3. health-check at 4965432130.
anita: rolling now to c1-c3. enabling extra debug logs for 20m.
marco: initial pass (5m): c1/c2 green, c3 shows sporadic 500s but decreasing. sample logs:
```
infer: deserialize optional_tensor failed: expected shape [B,L], got []
calling shim: fallback to compat-serializer
```
ci-bot: telemetry probe inserted: dump sample payloads when deserialize error rate > 0.1% for 5m.
rachel: after 20m, error rate down to baseline 0.02% across c1-c3, latency within thresholds. recommending to keep pin until TTL but mark for early unpin if stable 30m window holds.
tom: agree. add release note to pinned changelog: "SDK 2.7.3 pinned in us-east canary due to model-binding mismatch; patch refactor/skip-opt-optional-tensors deployed to canary and observed reduction in 5xxs."
deploybot: pin TTL set to expire at 4965435709. Will auto-unpin unless manual override.
anita: I'll monitor dashboards `canary/sdk/binding` and post status every 15m. tagging @tom for rollback authority if threshold breached.
marco: also let's add a snippet to sdk migration notes reminding about optional tensor shapes and backward-compatible marshalling. small docs PR after this.
ci-bot: when unpin occurs, run smoke-canary tests automatically and post result.
anita: thanks everyone. closing loop once auto-unpin or manual unpin happens. :white_check_mark:
